description:
JCalendar 1.4's JDateChooser API on top of SwingBridge Emulators, so a migrated
        application keeps compiling after rewriting its com.toedter imports to vaadinx.toedter.
        A clean reimplementation over a Vaadin date picker, not a fork of the upstream sources,
        licensed LGPL-2.1 like the library whose API it reproduces.
        Starter prototype: shipped as-is at the coverage it has.
